correctness.rationale: The cell update is exactly the Rule-184 Boolean multiplexer; explicit first/last and interior recurrences show one-sweep removal of the wrapped 10 interface. On the forward-invariant endpoint domain each 1-run erodes from the right except coupled endpoint runs, which have the proven combined clock. The initial wrapped case transforms in one sweep into this domain, producing the four exhaustive run cases. Positive-composition enumeration gives G_t and exact layers. The same clock proves the basin split and sharp unique extremizer; a second-moment bound for 01^k occurrences proves logarithmic expected depth. Independent finite checks compare exact trajectories and the run formula on 131064 configurations and the rational layer coefficients on 102 pairs through length 14. No inference from finite cases to the universal theorem is made.

value.rationale: Rule 184 is the canonical number-conserving synchronous traffic rule, whereas sequential in-place scanning destroys particle conservation. The theorem quantitatively resolves that structural change for all lengths: its complete exact first-passage census is a rational family indexed by depth, a unique worst-case configuration delays n-1 sweeps, the opposite consensus basin has only n states, and typical delay is logarithmic. This is a natural system-wide dynamical invariant beyond prior fixed-point existence or one-step image counting, and directly supports reproducible predictions at every ring size and delay.
